newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: INFRASTRUCTURE YEAR NET PROFIT A$27.9 MLN.
newsitem.headline: INFRASTRUCTURE YEAR NET PROFIT A$27.9 MLN.

text.p: Infrastructure Trust of Australia (ITA) said on Wednesday it had a net profit of A$27.9 million for the year to June 30, its maiden reporting year. The distribution was 5.5 cents per stapled security.

ITA said it expected to continue to provide strong returns to investors. Trust manager John Caldon said opportunities for further investment were expected to arise with the deregulation of the gas industry and further privatisation in the electricity sector.
ITA said its net operating profit compared with a prospectus forecast of A$15.3 million, while the distribution compared with a forecast of 5.3 cents per stapled security.
The Trust listed in December 1996. Its securities were issued at A$1.00 each.
ITA has interests in Sydney tollways as well as Melbourne's City Link tollway.
The Trust is managed by Macquarie Bank unit, Macquarie Infrastructure Investment Management Ltd.
